Three exact cases/probe/original-oracle overlays are recorded with complete content/mode/membership before/after guards; no submodule payload reads. Independent corrected review oracle and original author are both retained and bound. Runtime source/contracts do not change after the reviewer discovers a quoted case observation omitted from its initial expectation: the original false hypothesis is actually rejected and retained; original runtime inputs/capture remain exact. Scalar intervals come from independently authored literal fragments, never observed raw-text search. Two existing if origins per seed retain actual returned/constructor/argument references. Remaining Flow source gaps are diagnosed and scheduled under direct hooks, argument-authority diagnosis/bridge, recursive translation and canonical acceptance; no production recognition repair or new source origin is claimed here. Original full callback arrays are checked for public/private and seed equality, not independently admitted arbitrary custom callback semantics; custom/foreign/copied/error/nested argument authority remains a required follow-up. Complete substitution/diagnostics/parser dumps recur byte-for-byte across three seeds for each authored case; they are original observations, not a new runtime-execution claim. Six selected unchanged fixture suites, complete TAP plans/reach/nested-failure denial. Historical first exploratory live capture is limited and not immutable proof; first successful book render failed its inherited perl-only fence review and is retained separately. Final complete book capsule/render is independently checked; examples are teaching, not native execution. Gitlinks/nonregular metadata excluded without payload inspection; host OS/Perl/Python/prove/mdBook are necessary read-only prerequisites; project scratch on repository volume. Global history/claim/source-membership/comment/replacement/DSL/backend audits remain separately owned. No source/spec/standard-test/CI/hook/storage/dependency/other-repository changes.
